notes: 2026-10-29: Shopify collections.json lists denim-jeans_shop-all-jeans (119 products) but its products.json and the collection page return 0 products; /collections/womens-jeans 404. Store's jeans could not be read; no price.

2026-10-29 (charlotte-russe run): rue21.com is now a lookbook and store locator with no online shop (nav: Home, Lookbook, Store Locator). Meta description: 'Shop Rue21 for the latest women's and men's fashion at better prices than ever!'. Status set to verified: live and selling clothing in stores (enrich.md §2); the earlier unverified came from an unreadable jeans feed, not a dead site.
Store directory (rue21.com/tools/locations/directory): 'United States (121)' across 40 states, most in Georgia (12), Texas (11), Florida (8), North and South Carolina (7 each).

Wikipedia: third Chapter 11 on 1 May 2024, all 540 stores closed; YM Inc. bought its assets on 29 June 2024 and reopened stores; YM also owns Charlotte Russe and Urban Planet; sells women's and men's casual apparel. hq_country CA and parent from YM Inc. (Toronto).

Exchange policy: unworn items with receipt within 14 days for an exchange or gift card; 'Sorry, we do not offer refunds.' Clearance, intimates and pierced jewelry final sale. returns_days left empty because there are no refunds.

Sells dresses: the store's own product feed lists 'Striped Ribbed Off Shoulder Maxi Dress' (product type Womens Dresses, vendor Stitches, $16, out of stock online); collections.json lists a 'cr_-10-or-less-womens_dresses' collection (78 products, none published). No online price range, so no dresses price row.
